description: This Java class provides index operations for MongoDB, including creating, dropping, and retrieving indices on collections.

classes.name: IndexOperations
classes.description: Final class that manages index operations for MongoDB, including creating, dropping, and listing indices.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate IndexOperations with a given MongoDatabase.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index by name from a specified collection; does not fail if index is absent.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates an index on a collection with specified index model; throws if index with same name exists.

methods.name: getIndices
methods.description: Retrieves all indices on a collection, including the default '_id' index.

methods.name: getIndicesExceptDefaultIndex
methods.description: Retrieves all indices on a collection, excluding the default '_id' index.
